name: Do I need a building permit to remove and relocate a shower in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit to remove and relocate a shower in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners across Denver, Centennial, and Parker frequently ask this when planning renovations. Removing a shower pan or stall is generally part of interior remodeling, but if the project involves altering primary drainage stacks, moving water supply lines, or modifying load-bearing studs, local building jurisdictions require permits. Working with a registered general contractor ensures all trade coordination, from licensed plumbing work to structural framing and final finishes, complies with local municipal codes across the Denver metro area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple demolition often does not require permits, but relocating drains, altering plumbing supply lines, or modifying wall framing across the Denver area does require permits.
